title: Regionalization trend gains momentum as Canadian steel industry charts a path separate from US markets
dek: Fastmarkets reports that the Canadian steel industry is charting a path separate from US markets as a regionalisation trend gains momentum.
summary: According to Fastmarkets' headline, the Canadian steel industry is charting a path separate from US markets, as a broader regionalisation trend gains momentum. The publisher provided no excerpt, so the drivers and specific measures are not detailed in the material.
whyItMatters: Canada and the US have historically had closely integrated steel markets, so any divergence could reshape North American trade flows.
implications: Traders and mills with cross-border exposure may need to reassess sales channels, though the material gives no specifics.
